create_dataflow_graph: create a dataflow graph using model_opt.dataflow_graph.Graph for representing model computations
add_node_to_graph: add a named node with optional size and op_type to the dataflow graph
add_edge_between_nodes: add an edge with size and name connecting source nodes to sink nodes
canonicalize_graph: canonicalize the graph by converting MultiSourceEdges into regular single-source Edges
build_weighted_graph: build a dataflow graph with weight nodes and activation edges for model optimization
